other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Sikkim
Applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family
Eligibility arises upon the death of the primary breadwinner of the family
Financial assistance is paid to the household of the deceased, which includes spouse, minor children, unmarried daughters, and dependent parents
Applicant must have an account opened under Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
A woman homemaker in the family is also considered a breadwinner
benefits_summary: A one-time grant of ₹30,000 is provided to the bereaved household of a BPL family when the primary breadwinner dies.
